division-meaning-skill-01.target: I can share a total equally among a number of groups and write a division equation for how many are in each group.
division-meaning-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can share a total equally among a number of groups and write a division equation for how many are in each group.
division-meaning-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Making groups that are not equal, or giving the number of groups as the answer. Try this: Deal out counters one at a time to each group; check that every group has the same number.

division-meaning-skill-02.target: I can make groups of a given size from a total and write a division equation for how many groups there are.
division-meaning-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can make groups of a given size from a total and write a division equation for how many groups there are.
division-meaning-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking every division asks “how many in each group,” so the answer names the wrong quantity. Try this: Label the answer with its meaning: “6 bags” or “6 in each bag.” Act out both kinds with the same numbers.

division-meaning-skill-03.target: I can solve a division fact by finding the missing factor in a related multiplication fact and write fact families.
division-meaning-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve a division fact by finding the missing factor in a related multiplication fact and write fact families.
division-meaning-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing related facts in the wrong order (6 ÷ 42 = 7) or mixing up which number is the product. Try this: Use a triangle fact card: the product goes on top; cover a number and name the fact that finds it.

division-meaning-skill-04.target: I can solve sharing and grouping word problems within 100 with a drawing and a division equation.
division-meaning-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve sharing and grouping word problems within 100 with a drawing and a division equation.
division-meaning-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Multiplying the two numbers in the story whenever the word “each” appears. Try this: Draw a tape diagram: is the total known? If the total is known and a group size or count is missing, divide.
